metric_variants: annual rate (mL/yr); change to week 52; slope
threshold_or_mcid: No MCID defined in mL; MCID is defined in % (see E2/E3)
licenses: A between-group difference in mean decline over the trial period
does_not_license: 'preserves lung function', 'stabilises', survival benefit, symptom benefit
known_problems: Used as the primary endpoint of most pivotal trials; not anchored to any patient-perceived change; placebo-arm decline differs ~3-fold across trials, so cross-trial comparison of mL differences is not valid
evidence_level: Regulatory-accepted primary endpoint; no retrieved trial-level surrogate validation

prognostic_anchor: 24-week FVC decline of 5-10% -> >2-fold higher 1-year mortality (P<0.001); 'marginal' decline HR 2.31 (95% CI 1.19-4.50)
licenses: A clinically important difference only if the between-group difference reaches 2-6 %pred
known_problems: MCID derived largely from death/hospitalisation and distribution-based anchors; single value may not apply across severity strata or follow-up durations (PMID 34671666)
evidence_level: Anchor- and distribution-based MCID studies in trial cohorts

metric_variants: relative vs absolute definition; >=10% vs >=5%; with/without death as competing event
prognostic_anchor: Relative change maximises detection of >=10% decline without sacrificing prognostic accuracy; absolute change more predictive at the >=5% level; all thresholds of FVC and DLCO decline associated with death or transplant (PMID 40020995)
licenses: Proportion of patients crossing a prognostically meaningful threshold
does_not_license: Equivalence with the continuous FVC endpoint; pooling with mL differences
known_problems: Relative and absolute definitions are not interchangeable; choice changes both event rate and effect estimate

metric_variants: absolute vs relative decline; >=10% and >=15% thresholds
threshold_or_mcid: No IPF-specific MCID retrieved; >=10% decline used as prognostic threshold
prognostic_anchor: DLCO decline >=10% predicted mortality in a real-world pirfenidone cohort; for DLCO (unlike FVC) risk increase was generally greater for relative than absolute thresholds (PMID 40020995)
does_not_license: Substitution for FVC endpoints; symptom or survival claims
known_problems: Higher measurement variability than FVC; frequently a secondary or exploratory endpoint, so nulls are often underpowered rather than informative

metric_variants: change at 24/52 weeks; distance vs desaturation
prognostic_anchor: 24-week decline >50 m -> HR 4.27 (95% CI 2.57-7.10) for 1-year death
known_problems: Anchor-only re-estimation gives considerably higher MCID values than the original estimates (PMID 34671666); ceiling/floor effects by severity

metric_variants: SGRQ vs IPF-specific SGRQ-I; improvement vs deterioration
prognostic_anchor: Not a validated prognostic anchor for mortality in retrieved evidence
licenses: Patient-reported health-status change on the measured domain
known_problems: MCID differs by direction of change, so a symmetric threshold misclassifies deterioration; not interchangeable with K-BILD

does_not_license: Comparison against SGRQ thresholds; disease modification
known_problems: Published MID estimates differ by a factor of ~2-3 depending on method and direction; a trial can be 'positive' or 'null' depending on which is adopted

threshold_or_mcid: MCID for worsening 4-6, point estimate 6 (mild/moderate impairment)
prognostic_anchor: Anchored to FVC (6), 6MWD (4.3) and SGRQ-A (5.8) cut points
licenses: Patient-reported dyspnoea change in mild-to-moderate disease
does_not_license: Extrapolation to severe disease; disease modification
known_problems: Derived in mild/moderate impairment only; MCID for improvement not established in retrieved evidence

metric_variants: objective digital cough monitoring vs VAS vs Leicester Cough Questionnaire
threshold_or_mcid: No IPF-specific MCID retrieved for objective cough frequency or VAS
prognostic_anchor: None; cough is not a prognostic endpoint
licenses: Symptom effect only, over the measured interval (14 days in PACIFY COUGH)
does_not_license: Any statement about fibrosis, lung function, or progression
known_problems: Short measurement windows; entry requires VAS >=30 mm so results do not generalise to unselected patients

metric_variants: 2007 definition vs 2016 revised international working-group definition; 'acute respiratory deterioration' superset
prognostic_anchor: In-hospital mortality after AE 29.5% under the revised definition; revised definition raised measured incidence ~20% and lowered in-hospital mortality ~10% relative to the old one (PMID 35614114)
licenses: Change in the rate of a defined acute event, under the definition used
does_not_license: Comparison across trials using different definitions; substitution for mortality
known_problems: Definition change alters both numerator and prognosis, so historical and modern rates are not comparable; incidence estimates vary widely (3-year 18.6%; PMID 39256473)
evidence_level: Consensus definition + systematic review of cohorts

metric_variants: all-cause vs respiratory; death or transplant composite
does_not_license: Nothing weaker may substitute for it
known_problems: In mild-to-moderate IPF the event rate is low enough that the size, duration and cost of an all-cause-mortality trial are 'substantial and likely prohibitive' (PMID 24476390); consequently no pivotal IPF trial is powered for mortality

metric_variants: time to first vs rate; all-cause vs respiratory
prognostic_anchor: Not separately validated in retrieved evidence
known_problems: Definitions vary; observational estimates can move in the opposite direction to mortality estimates in the same cohort (PMID 36997445)

metric_variants: automated quantitative CT scores; visual semi-quantitative reads
prognostic_anchor: Automated quantitative CT change predicts outcome longitudinally (PMID 31196945)
licenses: Structural change of the measured feature
does_not_license: Reversal of fibrosis; functional or survival benefit
known_problems: Not a registration endpoint; methods are not standardised across centres, so cross-study pooling is not possible

measure: Progression-free survival / time to disease progression
metric_variants: components differ by trial (FVC threshold, death, hospitalisation, 6MWD)
licenses: Only the composite as defined in that trial
does_not_license: Comparison across trials; interpretation as survival benefit
known_problems: Component definitions are not standardised; a composite dominated by an FVC threshold inherits every problem of E3 while reading as a hard outcome

dimension: Recovery of lost function / reversal of fibrosis
licenses: Nothing; no IPF trial endpoint currently measures recovery of lost lung function
does_not_license: Any claim of reversal from FVC-slope, imaging or preclinical data
known_problems: This is the central endpoint gap: the outcome patients most want has no validated measure, no trial precedent and no regulatory pathway; sustained positive FVC slope has not been demonstrated in any completed IPF RCT arm
